SCIENCE ADVENTURE 21 · CLASS 31

Turtle’s Recycling Mission

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill Recycling sorting

Six clean items, three bins — paper, plastic or metal. Sort them all!

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · RECYCLING SORTING

Turtle’s Recycling Mission

Turtle needs a recycling helper! Tap a clean item, then tap its bin: PAPER, PLASTIC, or METAL.

Tap an item, then tap the bin it belongs in.

Recycling hero!

Paper and cardboard to PAPER, bottles to PLASTIC, cans to METAL — the planet says thank you!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Real-world science with instant practice: after the game, hunt the kitchen for one paper, one plastic and one metal item and sort them for real. Rinse first — clean items only!

Illustration note: Loaded by content: the file named elephants-air-power-lab actually carries this Turtle’s Recycling Mission artwork (the R2 export shifted files 20–30 by one slot).

Prefer paper? The Turtle’s Recycling Mission worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
